The work is RELOCATED, not abandoned: removing those three waiver rows and confirming B-8df9s gates pass without them is the first act of B-8df9s own closeout, under its own owner lease, which the ownership model requires anyway. My prior decision SD-ccafb44c recorded this at the checklist level only; recording it at the acceptance-binding level is what makes the narrowing visible to the DONE gate instead of leaving it implicit in summary prose.
